messages:
maria: Noticed an annoying parity bug in the Kotlin SDK suspend adapter + multipart file uploads. If auth interceptor triggers a refresh (401) while streaming a multipart body, the suspend path fails with an IOException and doesn't retry. Java callback path works. Repro in sampleapp on Android 13 emulator.

ben: That screams one-shot RequestBody. The OkHttp Call needs to be cloned for each attempt. The Java flow probably clones or re-creates the Call internally. Does the suspend adapter hold on to the original Call instance across retry logic?

maria: Looking at our suspend adapter (awaitResponse) it does `call.enqueue` and awaits results, but our auth interceptor triggers a token refresh and then replays by returning `chain.proceed(newRequest)` which relies on OkHttp retrying the cloned call. I think the difference is the suspend helper wraps Call but doesn't clone when re-executing.

lee: Any stack traces? Also which OkHttp version? There are subtle HTTP/2 stream reset behaviors on newer Android that show up as `java.io.IOException: closed` during writeTo.

maria: OkHttp 4.11.0. Stack: "401 Unauthorized", then `okio.ForwardingSink.write -> java.io.IOException: closed` coming out of RequestBody.writeTo. Happens only on API 33 in our smoke farm, not on API 28.

anika: Workaround: make multipart bodies repeatable by buffering, or avoid streaming large files with multipart if you expect auth refresh. Example cheap buffer util: ```kotlin
fun makeRepeatable(body: RequestBody): RequestBody = object : RequestBody() {
  val cache = Buffer().apply { body.writeTo(this) }
  override fun contentType() = body.contentType()
  override fun contentLength() = cache.size
  override fun writeTo(sink: BufferedSink) { sink.writeAll(cache.clone()) }
}
``` It's memory heavy but helps repro.

ben: Real fix for SDK: ensure the suspend adapter clones the Call on each execution: `val exec = original.clone()` before enqueue/execute. Also add a detect-and-log when RequestBody isn't repeatable so sample apps get a clear hint.

maria: Filed small internal issue INF-8812 and attached a tiny repro server that forces 401 after first chunk. Will add test that runs on emulator API 33/29.

ops-bot: build-bot: CI for branch fix/suspend-clone passed unit tests :white_check_mark: but flaky instrumented test on API 33 :hourglass_flowing_sand:.

lee: Good catch. Also consider adding `RepeatableRequestBody` util to our kotlin sdk so sample apps don't copy/paste. If we ship that, we should document the perf tradeoffs in onboarding.

anika: I'll prototype a PR that clones the call and adds the util + a logging warning when non-repeatable body is used. @maria can you drop the minimal repro zip in the issue so the test can run headless?

maria: Done, pushed repro to the INF ticket and pinned the emulator device logs. Thanks team.
